comparator_disclosure: group_supervised_val_comparator uses validation y-by-background labels. It is not an upper bound, does not alter the primary group-free choice, and uses no test group label to choose a policy.

fixed_0.03.selection_basis: predeclared fixed lambda=0.03 reference on the hidden-slice penalty scale

frozen_erm_reference.selection_basis: predeclared frozen ERM reference; no continuation and no repair

group_free.selection_basis: primary frozen rule: highest Bonferroni-adjusted cross-fit hidden-certificate lower score within the one-standard-error validation-NLL risk set; ties choose smaller lambda

group_supervised_val_comparator.selection_basis: post-hoc group-supervised comparator maximizing validation worst-group accuracy over the same one-standard-error risk set as the primary rule; ties choose the smallest lambda

matched_erm_lambda_0.selection_basis: matched continuation candidate with lambda=0 and no Fisher penalty

validation_risk_minimizer.selection_basis: minimum ordinary validation NLL; task labels only

posthoc_protocol.candidate_schema: frozen_erm_reference is audited separately; comparator and selected policies use only the matched lambda grid
posthoc_protocol.comparator_tie_break: smallest lambda_fg among equal validation worst-group accuracies
posthoc_protocol.metadata_role: post-hoc reporting and explicitly labeled group-supervised validation comparator only
